title: DecisionTraceRecordedPayload
description: Payload of the DecisionTraceRecorded event (catalogued in model/architecture/events.yaml, INV-NOTE-3 §19.8; class: domain). Authored by INV-T-2854 (T10). Within a major version this schema is additive-only (API-41, FR-K.4): a field is never removed, renamed, retyped or made required.

traceReference.description: Opaque reference to the underlying decision/evidence trace, resolvable by evidence-svc.

decisionTrace.description: The decision trace itself (opaque to this envelope; interpreted by evidence-svc and console-bff, FR-B.6).
